title: CMAR for Mountain's Edge Recreation Center & Regional Park
short_description: CMAR services for a recreation center and regional park phase in Las Vegas.
project_scope: Construction Manager at Risk services for the Mountain's Edge Recreation Center and Mountain's Edge Regional Park Phase II (SNPLMA). The project comprises a recreation center building and regional park development; no gross floor area, span, or further technical dimensions are stated in the source.
services: Construction Manager at Risk (CMAR) / construction manager-general contractor services; procurement is aimed at firms qualified for CMAR delivery. Disciplines requested: Design Build/Developer and Construction/Project Management.
relevance_explanation:
- Project is primarily a CMAR/construction management procurement, not a structural design tender.
- Recreation center building could involve building structures, but no complex structural features, long spans, or special engineering challenges are described.
- Regional park component suggests substantial non-structural site works.
- sbp generally deprioritizes pure project management/construction management opportunities.
- Moderate strategic relevance only if a later design/planning role could emerge through contractor collaboration.
construction_cost_explanation: Taken from the tender documents as a stated total construction cost range of $43.7M-$46.0M; value entered as the midpoint estimate in USD.
fee_explanation: No explicit design or engineering fee is stated. The notice is for CMAR services rather than structural engineering. Only total construction cost is given: $43.7M-$46.0M.
references_qualifications: Firms must be qualified as a construction manager/general contractor to provide CMAR services. No detailed minimum reference counts or specific technical qualification thresholds are stated in the source.
